verdict.rationale: Wise documents an API to create cards and spend-control rules based on merchant category code or transaction currency, which allows category-level scoping such as ad spend. However, the evidence never says the cards are virtual or issued instantly, and it is framed as a partner API for issuing cards to customers rather than a finance-lead workflow. Missing for 10: explicit virtual card issuance, instant creation, per-vendor (single merchant) scoping, a finance-lead-facing Wise Business UI flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can instantly create virtual cards scoped to a specific purpose like ad spend or a single vendor

citations.quote: With this set of APIs, you will be able to create cards for your customers.
Control which card transactions are permitted by creating rules based on merchant category code (MCC) or transaction currency.
Control spending permissions (e-commerce, ATM, contactless, magnetic stripe, etc.)
